signal_path: MOS pass-conductance synapses charge Cpre; NMOS source follower charges Cact as a ReLU-like activation.
model_level: ngspice built-in LEVEL=1 MOS models; not a foundry PDK.
weight_state: Cw0/Cw1 capacitor IC voltages drive NMOS synapse gates.
activation_state: Cact capacitor voltage after source-follower rectification.
gradient_state: not included in this primitive sweep
interpretation: This validates the first device-level replacement target for the behavioral local feature cell: conductance-weighted input integration followed by a capacitor-held ReLU-like activation. It does not yet implement signed weights, backprop delta storage, or gradient-update devices.
